Acid Spray.effect: 100% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 2.

Brick Break.effect: Destroys screens, unless the target is immune.

Clear Smog.effect: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

Curse.effect: Curses if Ghost, else -1 Spe, +1 Atk, +1 Def.

Dark Pulse.effect: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

Dazzling Gleam.effect: No additional effect. Hits adjacent foes.

Destiny Bond.effect: If an opponent knocks out the user, it also faints.

Drain Punch.effect: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

Endure.effect: User survives attacks this turn with at least 1 HP.

Energy Ball.effect: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Facade.effect: Power doubles if user is burn/poison/paralyzed.

Fling.effect: Flings the user's item at the target. Power varies.

Focus Blast.effect: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Focus Punch.effect: Fails if the user takes damage before it hits.

Foul Play.effect: Uses target's Attack stat in damage calculation.

Giga Drain.effect: User recovers 50% of the damage dealt.

Hex.effect: Power doubles if the target has a status ailment.

Hypnosis.effect: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Icy Wind.effect: 100% chance to lower the foe(s) Speed by 1.

Imprison.effect: No foe can use any move known by the user.

Knock Off.effect: 1.5x damage if foe holds an item. Removes item.

Mean Look.effect: Prevents the target from switching out.

Nasty Plot.effect: Raises the user's Sp. Atk by 2.

Night Shade.effect: Does damage equal to the user's level.

Pain Split.effect: Shares HP of user and target equally.

Payback.effect: Power doubles if the user moves after the target.

Perish Song.effect: All active Pokemon will faint in 3 turns.

Phantom Force.effect: Disappears turn 1. Hits turn 2. Breaks protection.

Poltergeist.effect: Fails if the target has no held item.

Psych Up.effect: Copies the target's current stat stages.

Psychic.effect: 10% chance to lower the target's Sp. Def by 1.

Psychic Noise.effect: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from healing.

Rain Dance.effect: For 5 turns, heavy rain powers Water moves.

Reflect Type.effect: User becomes the same type as the target.

Rest.effect: User sleeps 2 turns and restores HP and status.

Round.effect: Power doubles if others used Round this turn.

Self-Destruct.effect: Hits adjacent Pokemon. The user faints.

Shadow Punch.effect: This move does not check accuracy.

Skill Swap.effect: The user and the target trade Abilities.

Skitter Smack.effect: 100% chance to lower target's Sp. Atk by 1.

Sleep Talk.effect: User must be asleep. Uses another known move.

Snore.effect: User must be asleep. 30% chance to flinch target.

Spite.effect: Lowers the PP of the target's last move by 4.

Substitute.effect: User takes 1/4 its max HP to put in a substitute.

Sucker Punch.effect: Usually goes first. Fails if target is not attacking.

Sunny Day.effect: For 5 turns, intense sunlight powers Fire moves.

Taunt.effect: Target can't use status moves its next 3 turns.

Thief.effect: If the user has no item, it steals the target's.

Thunder.effect: 30% chance to paralyze. Can't miss in rain.

Toxic.effect: Badly poisons the target. Poison types can't miss.

Toxic Spikes.effect: Poisons grounded foes on switch-in. Max 2 layers.

Trick.effect: User switches its held item with the target's.

Trick Room.effect: Goes last. For 5 turns, turn order is reversed.

Venoshock.effect: Power doubles if the target is poisoned.

Wonder Room.effect: For 5 turns, all Defense and Sp. Def stats switch.
